newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines, Moslem rebels agree to talk peace.
newsitem.headline: Philippines, Moslem rebels agree to talk peace.

text.p: The Philippine government and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) signed an agreement on Friday to enforce a ceasefire and resume their peace negotiation, Defense Secretary Renato de Villa said.
Both parties agreed to form a committee which will formulate the rules regarding the implementation of a ceasefire. The committee is set to meet on July 30.
Both parties also agreed to "resume and proceed with the formal peace talks in a venue to be mutually agreed upon between the government and the MILF panels."
"(It is) imperative for the government and the MILF to enter into an agreement for general cessation of hostilities and to agree to continue the formal peace talks," the agreement said.
The MILF called off the peace talks last June 28 following a series of gunbattles in southern Mindanao island which claimed more than 150 combatants.
The MILF has been fighting for an Islamic state in the southern Mindanao island. Mindanao is the ancestral home of Philippine Moslems.
